GET /api/me/listening-sessions slices by page and itemsPerPage (itemsPerPage 0 or non-numeric falls back to 10), returns an empty slice past the end with the full total, and an empty list for a user without sessions.

GET /api/me/item/listening-sessions/:libraryItemId pages like the full list (itemsPerPage fallback 10) and returns an empty list for items the caller never played or only others played.

GET /api/me/listening-stats answers totalTime, items (per library item id: id, timeListening, mediaMetadata), days (date to seconds, only sessions with listening time), dayOfWeek, today and recentSessions (10 newest sessions); all zero/empty for a user without sessions; 401 without a valid token.

requirements.contract: POST /api/session/:id/close with a final sync stores the session with the total listening time, moves the progress, removes the open session, answers the owner's sockets with user_session_closed and the admins with one user_stream_update. Closing a session that never listened, with an empty body, stores no session row and touches no progress, but still removes the session and sends user_session_closed. Closing with an empty body after a sync keeps the synced row as stored and does not touch the progress. A session closes once: a second close or a later sync answers 404 and changes no row, progress or event. An admin can close another user's open session, as the web client's session dialog does; the stored session is kept and user_session_closed goes to the session owner's sockets.
